title: McCasland-DeLonge contacts as a disclosure operation meant to pave the way for a Hillary Clinton presidency

tellings.quote: when I say op, it's not a bad thing. That was an operation, meaning there were people trying to get [ __ ] out.

plain: The filmmaker Jeremy Corbell argues that the contacts in 2015 and 2016 between Neil McCasland, a senior Air Force officer, and the musician Tom DeLonge were an organised effort, an "op" in his word, by people inside the system trying to get UFO information out, and that it was meant to prepare the ground for a presidency of the politician Hillary Clinton. Corbell says "op" is not meant as an insult: "there were people trying to get [ __ ] out." He points to an email published by WikiLeaks, a site that posts leaked documents, and to the journalist George Knapp, and if he is right, a planned release of UFO secrets was tied to the 2016 election.
